name: Calvin / Nameloc
title: Guardian / Protector
subtitle: Spiritbound Guardian of the Great Hound
summary: Calvin is bonded to an ancient and powerful Dog Spirit. In moments of danger, loyalty, or protection, he can unleash the spirit as Nameloc—a massive glowing guardian hound. The spirit chose him for his courage, instinct, and willingness to stand between danger and his friends.
details: Calvin is the boy form; Nameloc is the bonded Great Hound spirit form.

powers.name: Keen Nose
powers.description: Tracks creatures, people, animals, magical disturbances, and unusual spiritual scents.

powers.name: Guardian Instinct
powers.description: Can react instantly to protect an ally in danger. The original guardian rule grants one automatic success per encounter.

powers.name: Unleash the Great Hound
powers.description: Once per session, Calvin transforms into Nameloc or summons Nameloc beside him as a separate 10–15-foot glowing guardian presence.

powers.name: Titan Leap
powers.description: Leap great distances, cross gaps, save allies, break obstacles, or slam into enemies and terrain.

powers.name: Pack Protector
powers.description: Shields allies with spirit energy. Enemies may roll with disadvantage against protected allies.

powers.name: Spirit Sight
powers.description: Sees invisible enemies, hidden magic, spiritual disturbances, and threats concealed from normal vision.

powers.name: Howl of the Great Hound
powers.description: Choose to frighten enemies or empower allies with advantage on their next action.

specialRules: After Spirit Form ends, Calvin becomes tired and cannot use it again until the next session. Spirit awakening may be triggered when a friend is in serious danger, a powerful enemy appears, a major story moment occurs, or Calvin chooses loyalty over fear.

inventory.name: Extending pole hammer
inventory.charges: Equipped by Calvin; freely extends or contracts to any length from a 5-foot walking stick to a 10-foot war hammer on a pole; unlimited transformations

sessionNotes: Great Hound appearance / glow: Blue glow. Plot mysteries: What is causing Calvin's strange dreams? Why do Fey creatures recognize Nameloc's glowing blue hue as though they recognize him, his magic, or its source? Great Hound personality, favorite move, and awakening catchphrase remain unrecorded.
